name: King Crimson

whyMatters.en: Robert Fripp–centered progressive band formed in 1968. Lineups change sharply across eras—from In the Court of the Crimson King (1969) to the 1980s dual-guitar Discipline group—while Fripp remains the constant.
whyMatters.zh: 以 Robert Fripp 为中心的 progressive 乐队，1968 年成立。阵容跨时期变动很大——从《In the Court of the Crimson King》（1969）到 1980 年代《Discipline》双吉他编制——Fripp 始终保留。

note.en: Opener of In the Court of the Crimson King; distorted vocal, saxophone, heavy riff.
note.zh: 《In the Court of the Crimson King》开场曲；失真人声、萨克斯、重 riff。

note.en: From Red (1974); long-form piece with slow build and late climax.
note.zh: 出自《Red》（1974）；长曲，慢起与后段高潮。

note.en: From Discipline; Belew vocal/guitar with Fripp interlocking guitar lines.
note.zh: 出自《Discipline》；Belew 人声/吉他与 Fripp 交织吉他线条。

interviewQuotes.speaker: Robert Fripp

interviewQuotes.speaker: Robert Fripp

shortBio.en: London progressive rock, 1968–. Fripp constant across casts; Schizoid Man, Starless, and Elephant Talk mark three eras.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦 progressive rock，1968 年至今。Fripp 跨阵容保留；《Schizoid Man》、《Starless》、《Elephant Talk》标记三个时期。

body.en:
King Crimson formed in London in 1968. The debut In the Court of the Crimson King (1969) sets Mellotron textures against dissonant rock. The mid-1970s Wetton/Bruford years add improvisation and long pieces such as Starless. The 1981 Belew/Levin/Bruford lineup uses interlocking guitar parts on Discipline (Elephant Talk).

Fripp remains across reforms; bass, drums, vocals, and reeds change by decade. Later projects continue under the same name with new casts.
body.zh:
King Crimson 于 1968 年在伦敦成立。首专《In the Court of the Crimson King》（1969）把 Mellotron 织体与不协和摇滚并置。1970 年代中期 Wetton/Bruford 年加入即兴与《Starless》一类长曲。1981 年 Belew/Levin/Bruford 阵容在《Discipline》上使用交织吉他（《Elephant Talk》）。

Fripp 在重组中保留；贝斯、鼓、人声与簧乐按年代更换。之后项目仍以同名与新阵容继续。

body.en:
King Crimson keeps the name and Fripp’s standards while replacing instrumental casts.

That differs from a stable four-piece catalog like Led Zeppelin IV—useful contrast in this chronicle.
body.zh:
King Crimson 保留名称与 Fripp 的标准，同时更换乐器人马。

这与 Led Zeppelin IV 一类稳定四人编制不同——在本编年中可作对照。

body.en:
Each era has a distinct sound: Mellotron-led debut rock, freer mid-70s improvisation, then interlocking dual guitar on Discipline.

The versions are the catalog, not side notes.
body.zh:
每个时期声音不同：Mellotron 主导的首专摇滚、偏自由的 70 年代中期即兴，再到《Discipline》上的双吉他交织。

这些版本就是目录本身，不是旁注。

body.en:
Distorted vocal, saxophone, and a heavy riff open the 1969 debut. The track attacks from the first bars rather than only floating on Mellotron pads.

Metal and math-rock listeners still cite it as an early reference.
body.zh:
失真人声、萨克斯与重 riff 打开 1969 年首专。这首曲从开头就进攻，而不只靠 Mellotron 铺底漂浮。

金属与 math-rock 听众仍常把它当作早期参照。

body.en:
Guitar and composition stay centered on Fripp. Bass, drums, vocals, and reeds change across decades.

Read the members list as a version picker by era.
body.zh:
吉他与作曲以 Fripp 为中心。贝斯、鼓、人声、簧乐跨年代更换。

把成员列表按时期当版本选择器阅读。

body.en:
Fripp’s public talk about practice and craft matches a catalog that rewards close listening.

Those interview lines sit beside the records as archival material.
body.zh:
Fripp 关于练习与工艺的公开谈话，与一份奖励细听的目录相符。

这些采访短句可作为档案材料，与唱片并列阅读。

title.zh: 后来 prog 与实验引用

body.en:
Tool, math rock, and experimental metal have cited shifting meters and frequent lineup change.

The influence is both sonic and procedural: how a band reconstitutes itself.
body.zh:
Tool、math rock 与实验金属曾引用变换拍号与频繁阵容更换。

影响兼及声音与程序：乐队如何重组自身。

note.en: In the Court of the Crimson King–era Mellotron lineup.
note.zh: 《In the Court of the Crimson King》时期 Mellotron 阵容。
Belew/Levin/Bruford 交织吉他时期；专辑《Discipline》。

note.en: Debut album opener; distorted vocal and heavy riff on 1969 prog.
note.zh: 首专开场曲；1969 年 prog 上的失真人声与重 riff。

note.en: Progressive rock with repeated lineup reform under Fripp.
note.zh: 在 Fripp 下反复重组阵容的 progressive rock。
